sources.title: Setting up a server - Archean Wiki

notes: No remote command channel found. The developer-maintained wiki documents the whole dedicated server surface - server.ini (listen_port 8881 TCP+UDP, server_online, accept_remote_connections, max_simultaneous_players, password, automatic_blacklist), admins.txt, mods, Docker - and never mentions RCON, a web/REST admin API, or typing commands at the server process. Archean_server[.exe] does run "in console mode", but the wiki describes that console only as an interactive first-run configuration prompt (it stops asking once server_public_name is set in server.ini); nothing states it accepts kick/ban/list input afterwards, so stdin was NOT recorded rather than guessed. Moderation exists, but only from inside a connected game client: an admin (player id listed one per line in /Archean-data/server/admins.txt, Steam64 ID for Steam players) types chat commands - /list (connected players), /info (server name, CPU load, ticks/s), /kick <username|id>, /ban <username|id>, /save - or uses the F4 administration panel, whose Players tab can kick. There is no documented broadcast/say command and no documented ban-list file, so no banList is recorded. Confidence is low because every statement above traces back to the one official wiki (and its GitHub source); no independent second source covers Archean server administration, and no source contradicts it either. If a future build adds a server console command reader or RCON this file must be revisited.
